title: 读懂化学品的安全语言（国内版）
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/09_Module 4 — Hazard Communication.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/09_Module 4 — Hazard Communication（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 危害告知是安全的语言
points.K3: 全球统一的分类和标签
points.K9: 安全技术说明书是字典
points.K14: 配方可保密，安全信息不可

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一瓶贴有危险象形图的试剂瓶，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a reagent bottle with a blank label and a GHS hazard pictogram and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：读懂化学品的安全语言。
overlay: 读懂化学品的安全语言

shots.scene: 标签、说明书、培训三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a bottle label with a red diamond pictogram, a thick blank safety data sheet booklet, and a training board. No people.
shots.narration: 标签是字母，说明书是字典。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起台面上一只没贴标签的洗瓶，疑惑地闻了闻方向
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up an unlabeled wash bottle from the bench and looks at it with confusion, holding it at arm's length.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面上发现一只没标签的洗瓶。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，身旁浮现问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark floating beside him.
shots.narration: 里面是水？是溶剂？他完全不知道。

shots.scene: 小研拿走洗瓶，放到一边，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes the wash bottle away, sets it aside and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：不知道是什么，就别用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 化学品会“说话”，前提是我们读得懂。

shots.section_title: 危害告知是安全的语言
shots.scene: 试剂瓶、快递箱、交接班的时钟三个图标，各冒出一个对话气泡
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each with a speech bubble: a reagent bottle, a delivery box, and a clock for shift change. No people.
shots.narration: 每个容器、每批到货、每次交接，
overlay: 危害告知是安全的语言

shots.section_title: 危害告知是安全的语言
shots.scene: 成堆的文件被翻成一个对话气泡里的危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A stack of paperwork transforms into a speech bubble showing a GHS hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 都在用这门语言传递危险信息。

shots.section_title: 危害告知是安全的语言
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰对着试剂瓶标签交流
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student discuss a reagent bottle label together at the bench.
shots.narration: 会读、会说、会转告，大家才安全。

shots.scene: 实验室、仓库、走廊三个场所图标，都有一个化学品瓶
shots.prompt_en: Three place icons, a lab, a storeroom and a corridor, each containing a chemical bottle with a red diamond. No people.
shots.narration: 只要有危险化学品的地方，

shots.scene: 三个场所都打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: All three place icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 就要做好危害告知，没有例外。

shots.section_title: 全球统一的分类和标签
shots.scene: 地球图标周围排着统一的危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by matching GHS hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 联合国制定了全球统一的化学品制度。
overlay: 全球统一的分类和标签

shots.section_title: 全球统一的分类和标签
shots.scene: 分类、标签、说明书三个图标连在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons: a classification chart, a bottle label and a blank data sheet booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 分类、标签、说明书，格式都统一。

shots.section_title: 全球统一的分类和标签
shots.scene: 两个不同城市图标里的人看着同样的标签
shots.prompt_en: Two city skyline icons, each with a person pictogram reading the same bottle label with a red diamond. No people.
shots.narration: 各国的人，看到的是同样的警示。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶原装标签特写：象形图、空白文字框
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a manufacturer's bottle label with GHS pictograms and blank text areas. No people.
shots.narration: 原装标签由生产厂家贴好，

shots.scene: 撕标签的手势图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand peeling off a bottle label, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能撕、不能涂改，要保持完好。

shots.scene: 小研把溶剂从原瓶倒进洗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student transfers solvent from a large original bottle into a wash bottle inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 把化学品分装到洗瓶、烧杯里，

shots.scene: 小研给洗瓶贴上空白标签和象形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a blank label with a GHS pictogram onto the wash bottle.
shots.narration: 新容器也要贴标签，写清名称和危害。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着放大镜逐一检查台面上的洗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks each wash bottle on the bench with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 检查时，台面上的洗瓶一个个都会看。

shots.scene: 八个危险象形图排成两行
shots.prompt_en: A grid of GHS hazard pictograms: flame, skull and crossbones, exclamation mark, corrosion, health hazard, exploding bomb, flame over circle and gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图是红框菱形，一眼就能认出。

shots.scene: 火焰和圆圈上方火焰两个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The flame pictogram and the flame over circle pictogram are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 火焰是易燃，圆圈加火焰是氧化性。

shots.scene: 骷髅和健康危害两个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The skull and crossbones pictogram and the health hazard silhouette pictogram are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 骷髅是急性毒性，人形是慢性健康危害。

shots.scene: 腐蚀和感叹号两个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The corrosion pictogram and the exclamation mark pictogram are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀是腐蚀性，感叹号是刺激等危害。

shots.scene: 爆炸弹和气瓶两个图标高亮
shots.prompt_en: The exploding bomb pictogram and the gas cylinder pictogram are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 爆炸弹是爆炸性，气瓶是加压气体。

shots.scene: 两张标签：一张象形图配深色横条，一张配浅色横条
shots.prompt_en: Two blank bottle labels side by side, one with a pictogram and a bold dark banner, the other with a pictogram and a lighter banner. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图旁边还有信号词。

shots.scene: 温度计式的刻度，上端红色、下端黄色
shots.prompt_en: A severity scale bar, red at the top and yellow at the bottom, with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: “危险”更严重，“警告”相对较轻。

shots.scene: 老周把一小瓶溶剂倒进洗瓶，准备自己用
shots.prompt_en: The older man pours a small amount of solvent into a squeeze bottle for his own use at the bench.
shots.narration: 老周分装一洗瓶溶剂，只是自己当天用。

shots.scene: 洗瓶旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A squeeze bottle with a large question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说，国外有的条款允许免贴。

shots.scene: 老周在洗瓶上贴上写有名称的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The older man sticks a blank label onto the squeeze bottle and writes on it with a marker.
shots.narration: 在国内高校，所有容器都要有标签。

shots.scene: 老周离开后，阿杰走过来看清了标签
shots.prompt_en: After the older man leaves, the young male student walks up and reads the label on the squeeze bottle clearly.
shots.narration: 人走了瓶还在，标签替你说话。

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书是字典
shots.scene: 一本厚厚的空白说明书，旁边是字典图标
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank safety data sheet booklet next to a dictionary icon. No people.
shots.narration: 标签是字母表，说明书就是字典。
overlay: 安全技术说明书是字典

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书是字典
shots.scene: 旧的格式杂乱的纸张变成整齐的16格文件
shots.prompt_en: Messy old papers of different layouts turn into a neat document divided into sixteen blank sections. No people.
shots.narration: 现行说明书统一为16个部分。

shots.scene: 说明书分成四段，第一段亮起：身份证图标
shots.prompt_en: The data sheet split into four sections; the first lights up with an ID card icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第1到3部分：是什么，有什么危害。

shots.scene: 第二段亮起：急救、灭火器、泄漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The second section lights up with icons of a first aid kit, a fire extinguisher and a spill. No people.
shots.narration: 第4到6部分：急救、消防、泄漏处理。

shots.scene: 第三段亮起：储存柜、手套、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: The third section lights up with icons of a storage cabinet, gloves and goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 第7到8部分：操作、储存和防护。

shots.scene: 小研对照说明书检查自己的手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares her gloves and goggles against a blank data sheet page.
shots.narration: 你戴的防护，要和第8部分对得上。

shots.scene: 第四段亮起：烧瓶、反应、骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth section lights up with icons of a flask, a reaction burst and a skull. No people.
shots.narration: 第9到11部分：性质、反应性和毒性。

shots.scene: 王老师请阿杰出示一份说明书，阿杰在电脑上调出
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator asks the young male student for a data sheet; he pulls it up on a lab computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 检查时要你几分钟内调出说明书。

shots.scene: 电脑屏幕旁打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A computer monitor with a blank document on screen and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 工作时能随时查到，电子版也可以。

shots.scene: 停电图标，旁边一个纸质文件夹打勾
shots.prompt_en: A power outage icon next to a printed binder with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 还要有纸质备份，停电断网也能查。

shots.scene: 王老师给一组学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in a training room with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 让每个人都会读这门语言，

shots.scene: 培训和资料共享两个图标相连
shots.prompt_en: A training board icon linked to a shared folder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 靠正式培训，也靠信息共享。

shots.scene: 缺标签的洗瓶，旁边放着一叠空白标签模板
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled wash bottle beside a stack of blank pre-printed label templates on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 缺分装标签？台边备好标签模板。

shots.scene: 购物车图标连到说明书文件夹，自动刷新箭头
shots.prompt_en: A shopping cart icon linked to a data sheet folder with an automatic refresh arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书过期？新购入时同步更新。

shots.scene: 只有签名的表格变成带测验勾选的记录
shots.prompt_en: A sign-in sheet with only signatures turns into a record with topics and quiz check boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 培训只签到？记下内容和考核结果。

shots.scene: 实验室门口一道关卡图标，外来人员先听告知
shots.prompt_en: A checkpoint gate icon at a lab door where a visitor pictogram stops for a briefing. No people.
shots.narration: 外来人员？进门前先告知危害。

shots.section_title: 配方可保密，安全信息不可
shots.scene: 一个上锁的配方本，旁边说明书照样列出危害和防护
shots.prompt_en: A locked recipe book icon beside an open data sheet still showing hazard pictograms, gloves and a first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 厂家可以对具体成分保密，
overlay: 配方可保密，安全信息不可

shots.section_title: 配方可保密，安全信息不可
shots.scene: 危害、防护、急救三个图标一个都不少，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a hazard pictogram, protective gear and a first aid cross, all with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 但危害、防护、急救信息一样不能少。

shots.scene: 夜里的时钟，医生打电话
shots.prompt_en: A clock showing late night next to a telephone icon and a doctor's stethoscope. No people.
shots.narration: 有人接触了保密配方，医生急需成分。

shots.scene: 上锁的配方本被打开，信息传给医生
shots.prompt_en: The locked recipe book opens and information flows to a doctor icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 厂家不能拒绝，救人第一。

shots.scene: 老李带着工具来到实验室走廊施工
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer arrives with a toolbox to work in a lab corridor near a ventilation duct.
shots.narration: 维修人员进实验室区域施工，

shots.scene: 小研向老李讲解，指着门口的警示标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student briefs the facility engineer and points at a hazard warning sign by the lab door.
shots.narration: 实验室要主动讲清有什么危险。

shots.scene: 双向箭头连接两个人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A two-way arrow connecting two person pictograms, one with a toolbox and one with a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 施工方也要主动问，信息双向流动。

shots.scene: 深夜的收货处，一个快递箱被放进角落
shots.prompt_en: A delivery box is set down in a corner of a receiving room at night, with a moon outside the window. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：一瓶特殊试剂深夜送到，

shots.scene: 第二天早上，一个人形打开箱子直接分装，说明书被放在一边
shots.prompt_en: Next morning, a person pictogram opens the box and starts transferring the reagent while the data sheet lies unopened. No people.
shots.narration: 第二天直接分装，没看说明书。

shots.scene: 手部皮肤发红的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand with red irritated skin and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 一天多后，出现严重的接触性皮炎。

shots.scene: 说明书翻开，露出致敏标志和手套、面罩图标
shots.prompt_en: The data sheet opens to show a health hazard pictogram alongside chemical gloves and a face shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原来它是强致敏物，需要专用防护。

shots.scene: 收货和分装两个环节被红圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Two steps in a process flow, receiving and transferring, circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 收货和分装，最容易漏掉告知。

shots.scene: 实验室地面泄漏图标，时钟开始计时
shots.prompt_en: A spill icon on a lab floor with a stopwatch starting. No people.
shots.narration: 原片案例：一次酸泄漏，

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员用平板调出说明书
shots.prompt_en: The security officer looks up a blank data sheet on a tablet while walking toward the lab.
shots.narration: 应急人员几分钟内就拿到了说明书。

shots.scene: 化学品清单和说明书文件夹用链条连起来
shots.prompt_en: A chemical inventory list icon linked by a chain to a data sheet folder. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品台账和说明书联动，抢回时间。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰在实验台边自然地聊着标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student chat casually about a bottle label at the bench.
shots.narration: 安全语言，不是一年听一次的讲座，

shots.scene: 欣欣指着台面上的标签和说明书文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at labeled bottles and a data sheet binder on the bench.
shots.narration: 此刻出事，标签清楚吗？说明书在吗？

shots.scene: 王老师在采购单上勾选，旁边一书一签图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks a blank purchase form beside icons of a data sheet booklet and a bottle label.
shots.narration: 买化学品，要求供应商提供一书一签。

shots.scene: 小研验收到货，核对瓶上标签和说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student receives a delivery and checks the bottle label against the data sheet.
shots.narration: 到货先验收，标签说明书要齐全。

shots.scene: 没有标签的到货瓶被放回箱子，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled delivered bottle is put back into its box, marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 缺签缺书，不收、不用。

shots.scene: 阿杰在自配溶液瓶上写标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes on a blank label on a bottle of solution he has just prepared.
shots.narration: 自己配的溶液，同样要贴标签。

shots.scene: 只写了缩写的瓶子图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle with only a short scribble on its label, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只写缩写或代号，别人看不懂。

shots.scene: 被腐蚀、字迹模糊的标签特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a corroded, faded bottle label that is hard to read. No people.
shots.narration: 标签被腐蚀、模糊、脱落，

shots.scene: 小研核对后贴上新标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student confirms the contents with the older man and sticks a fresh blank label on the bottle.
shots.narration: 确认无误后及时补贴新标签。

shots.scene: 在旧标签上胡乱涂改的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of messy scribbles over an old label, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要随手涂改、覆盖原标签。

shots.scene: 实验室门口张贴着空白安全信息牌，上有象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety information board with GHS pictograms posted beside a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 门口的安全信息牌，也是危害告知。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员在门口看信息牌后打电话
shots.prompt_en: The security officer reads the safety information board at the lab door and makes a phone call.
shots.narration: 出了事，外面的人一看就知道找谁。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现原装标签和分装标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of an original bottle label and a wash bottle label.
shots.narration: 原装标签保完好，分装容器都贴签。

shots.scene: 危险象形图和信号词横条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of GHS hazard pictograms with a signal word banner. No people.
shots.narration: 认得象形图，分得清危险和警告。

shots.scene: 说明书四段图标和纸质备份
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a four-part data sheet and a printed binder backup. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书四步查，随时能找到。

shots.scene: 门口关卡和双向箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a door checkpoint and a two-way information arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 收货先查书，外来人员先告知。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着贴好标签的试剂瓶挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a properly labeled reagent bottle and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 读懂安全语言，下次见！
